tri_glass.text: I'm a Glass. My family has been here since William Glass, and he was from Kelso, in the Scottish Borders. He had his own flag, his own rules, and a wife who kept the rest of them in order.
We say 'Yes' to everything here, because it's more polite. You can always change your mind later.

tri_green.text: I'm a Green. Peter Green was a Dutch sailor who came ashore in the 1830s and stayed. Sailors have been doing that here since the first ship, and I think the potatoes are why.
The Greens, the Glasses and the rest got on, married and argued, and made a place that works. It's a very small place, and everyone has an opinion about it.

tri_repetto.text: We're Repettos and Lavarellos. Two Italian sailors off the Italia, a barque wrecked on Tristan in 1892. They came from the little town of Camogli, near Genoa, and stayed.
Nobody's had a bad word to say about their cooking since. Tristan has a good deal of garlic.

tri_rogers.text: I'm a Rogers. We started with an American whaler, Andrew Rogers, who came in the 1830s. Whaling ships used to put in at Tristan for water and potatoes, and he chose a different life.
I can tell you the whole story, but I'd rather you went up to the Patches and saw the potatoes yourself.

tri_knitter.text: We knit hats, gloves, jumpers, socks. The sheep's wool goes round and round the island a few times before it is a jumper. I'll tell you now: a Tristan hat will see you through a winter in the Atlantic.
Every stitch is for somebody. If there's a gale coming and you've none to hand, you'll be offered one.

tri_birder.text: Rockhoppers. We count them from the cliff paths and the boats. In the last century their numbers have fallen by about nine in ten, which is a thing you say very gently.
A penguin will stare at you as though you've taken its seat. It's a good lesson. They've been there longer.

tristan_da_cunha_return.text: The ship is in. Strictly, there is no flight from Tristan, because we've no airstrip. The RAF drops you at Cape Town and a fishing boat does the rest. You've done the rest. Shall we get you back?

then.text: Our friend of the island! Come and have a cup of tea any time. And bring your own hat.
You've heard the names of the founders, from the ones who carry them. The Council is pleased. Now, a bit of island custom: a friendly fight, with no hard feelings and a lot of tea after.
Well fought. The island makes you an honorary Tristanian for a day. Here is a hat of our own wool, and a basket of our own potatoes.

else.text: Four families will tell you where their names came from. A Glass, a Green, a Repetto and a Rogers. Talk to each of them, and come back.

Hello! You've come a long way. Would you like to hear where we all came from? Four families will tell you: a Glass, a Green, a Repetto and a Rogers. Find them in the Settlement, and then come back to me.
